Noelle once was an athletic girl, you remember when you met her in college and she was lean and fit! However when adulthood hit both of you she started to exercise less for many reasons, day to day life got quite busy specially after she got work on a Kentucky Fried Chicken joint. 

That did add up overtime however, as the restaurant was far from home where you two lived it was not exactly feasible for her to eat anything other than what the Colonel could offer, that and the discounts were more than enough reason for her to eat fried chicken goods all day, which eventually led your once skinny girlfriend to really baloon up in weight and size.

You never had the heart to tell her she should exercise, she was a very hardworking woman and she always returned to your apartment so tired. Besides she really was just the same old Noelle you fell in love with, nothing changed, even if she was smelling of grease sometimes. If anything the only thing you would complain is the fact you and here weren't having much time for yourselves. That all changed when she got promoted to role... of manager!

Besides celebrating as you both did, Noelle being proud of her achievement and you almost bursting of joy, she made you an offer. That you could take her place on the role she used to fill and work with her! Which would both allow you both to be around each other, and you guys would also have double income which could make your life as a couple easier! Needless to say, you accepted in a heartbeat.

However unbeknownst to you, Noelle did keep secret some other intentions she had regarding you working there, she's not been fattening herself out of accident... well maybe in the begining but definetly not now. Your innocent looking girlfriend had acquired some... new tastes working on the fast food joint, she was surrounded by fatties all day and the more she interacted with them, the more she started to feel more things about obesity other than doing a good job to her customers.

Needless to say, she loved you so much, it was not everyone who would've sticked with her specially after such drastic changes. So she would want to return the favor! And adding to that, show you why she likes her job so much.
